statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Delayed NQ has retraced from a new overnight high while remaining net higher, and granular failed-retracement evidence remains incomplete.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold; the first post-holiday U.S. cash open remains the main conditional structure checkpoint.
headline: Nasdaq Tail remains WATCH after an overnight high and partial retracement
body: Delayed NQ reached 29,722.75 and was around 29,668.75 at 04:02 UTC, roughly 54 points below the overnight high while remaining above the 29,584.50 open and 29,603.50 prior close. The pullback weakens the one-way case, while repeated failed pullbacks are not verified. Oil near $97, elevated Treasury yields and Gulf escalation keep Stress extreme as broader equity signals remain mixed.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock-hours are available. Tail ranged 17%-24%, Stress remained 100%, and published modes shifted from event/whipsaw to mixed after the holiday reopen.
outlookSummary: Current retracement from the overnight high keeps Tail below the blocking threshold despite extreme Stress. The principal conditional danger window is 13:20-15:00 UTC around the first post-holiday U.S. cash open; only persistent extreme-holding with failed pullbacks and further extension moves Tail into the blocking band.

forecast.analysis: Observed delayed NQ is around 29,668.75 after reaching 29,722.75, leaving a roughly 54-point retracement from the overnight high while still above the 29,584.50 open and 29,603.50 prior close. The pullback weakens the one-way case; Tail remains WATCH.
drivers: NQ has retraced meaningfully from the overnight high while remaining net higher
